## Change summary

Describe the behavior, evidence, and rollback implications.

## Change class

- [ ] Documentation / non-runtime
- [ ] Observability-only
- [ ] Telemetry / ingest
- [ ] Predictive / advisory
- [ ] Command, safety, or deployment

## Required evidence

- [ ] The locked baseline suite passes locally or failures are explained.
- [ ] Relevant named RT/GW/CD regressions were added or updated.
- [ ] No secret, runtime state, generated archive, or production credential is included.
- [ ] Authority remains advisory and the independent hardware interlock is unchanged.
- [ ] State/queue compatibility and rollback impact are documented.
- [ ] Workflow, deployment, safety-model, or gateway changes have the required owner review.
